verdict.rationale: An official ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows is documented as a single workspace for running projects, using files and using your computer (docs-32, docs-105), and a community user confirms the macOS app. Computer Use lets ChatGPT see and operate graphical interfaces on macOS or Windows, with screenshots covered by data controls (docs-10, docs-89). Floating Pets controls give a system-level entry point for typing or voice (docs-105). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OS-level keyboard shortcuts or a global hotkey, and independent hands-on corroboration of the screen-access feature.
